INTRODUCTION_BIO:
My name is Erik Welander, and I'm a 34-year-old software engineer with nearly 10 years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining complex systems across both frontend and backend, as well as working with Linux/Unix systems and infrastructure.

My preferred programming languages are Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, and JavaScript, with a healthy dose of Bash scripting for automation.

On the backend, I primarily work with Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.  
For frontend development, I tend to favor server-side rendered React applications using Next.js, although I'm equally comfortable working with Angular or plain JavaScript when it's a better fit for the project.

Beyond software development, I have a strong interest in Linux, system administration, and computer networking, particularly IPv4 and IPv6.

One example is my personal [Kira Router project](https://github.com/Kira9204/kira-router), where I experiment with and deepen my understanding of technologies such as nftables, Unbound, and Linux networking and routing using 'iproute2'.

I enjoy working across the entire development lifecycle, from initial design and implementation to deployment, maintenance, and long-term improvement.
